prompt.en: A subterranean organism absorbs nutrients through thread-like structures spread over a large underground area, while remaining entirely fixed in one position. Predict how its structural solutions will compare with those of a grazing animal, and justify your prediction.

level1.en: Identify the constraint this organism shares with a plant, and state what that constraint implies for the tissues it requires.

clue.en: The organism cannot move to reach resources. Which other group of living things faces exactly that constraint?

level2Template.en: Whatever it is composed of, this organism is ___, exactly as a plant is.

accepted: fixed in one position and unable to move to its resources
stationary and must bring resources to itself

text.en: The organism is fixed in place and gathers resources by spreading outward rather than by travelling.
Because the organism is ___, its tissues will resemble those of a plant more closely than those of an animal.
